clauses.text: The photo identification requirement is repealed. A voter at a polling place shall state their name and address and sign the poll book.

current_law: Before receiving a ballot at a polling place, a voter must present a current government-issued photo identification, or cast a provisional ballot that is counted if the voter presents identification within six days. The state issues identification cards free of charge to any registered voter who requests one.
